source.html:
Lemon Velvet Butter Sauce
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Ingredients
  • ⅓ Cup(s) dry white wine
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) finely chopped shallots
  • 4 Teaspoon(s) fresh lemon juice
  • 1 Tablespoon(s) all-purpose flour
  • 1 Cup(s) heavy whipping cream
  • ½ Cup(s) butter, cut into 8 pieces
Instructions
  1. Combine wine, shallots and lemon juice in 10-inch skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until mixture comes to a boil (5-7 minutes). Continue boiling until liquid almost evaporates (4-5 minutes).
  2. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add flour; mix well. Slowly stir in cream with wire wisk until well mixed. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils (1-2 minutes). Stir in butter until melted; season wit salt and ground white pepper to taste.
